g.text: Article, SenderProfile — via services, no FK
Each box is one JPA entity class of the Quarkus application; attribute types are Kotlin types.
Invoice, InvoiceItem, TripExpense, TravelExpenseEntry — one repository, cascaded together
Recipient, SenderProfile, Article — each owns its own child rows
TaxRate, NumberRange — standalone, referenced by FK only
Receipt — linked, never owned, by any invoice/item
GenerationJob — own repository, bridges to kotlin-xpdf
